activities.safety_hold_point: All team members must complete HSE induction
activities.acceptance_criteria: Commissioning team in place and trained

activities.safety_hold_point: N/A
activities.acceptance_criteria: Approved integrated commissioning schedule with key milestones

activities.safety_hold_point: E&I system isolation verified before turnover
activities.acceptance_criteria: All systems broken down into turnover packages with signed MC dossiers

activities.activity: Hydrostatic testing (gasifier, FT reactor, hydrocracker, columns, HX, piping)
prerequisites: Construction mechanical completion of respective systems
activities.safety_hold_point: Test pressure not to exceed 1.5x design pressure; area must be barricaded
activities.acceptance_criteria: No leaks at test pressure held for minimum 30 minutes per ASME B31.3

activities.safety_hold_point: Pneumatic test hazard review mandatory; remote pressurisation only
activities.acceptance_criteria: Zero leakage at 110% of maximum allowable working pressure

activities.safety_hold_point: All loops de-energised during continuity check
activities.acceptance_criteria: 100% loops checked; signal accuracy within 0.5% of span

activities.safety_hold_point: SIS override permits must be managed per PTW system
activities.acceptance_criteria: All logic functions, interlocks, and alarms verified per cause-and-effect matrix

activities.activity: Megger tests, motor bump, rotation check, heat trace verification
activities.safety_hold_point: Lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) in place for all motor bump tests
activities.acceptance_criteria: Insulation resistance > 1 MΩ per kV; motor rotation correct; heat trace continuity verified

activities.activity: Piping flush, chemical clean, steam blow
activities.procedure_required: COM-009: Line flushing and chemical cleaning procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical handling PPE mandatory; ventilation confirmed
activities.acceptance_criteria: Flush targets met (particulate count, cleanliness standard per piping spec); steam blow clean per target disc

activities.activity: Relief valve setting and flare blow-down system test
activities.procedure_required: COM-010: Relief valve and flare test procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Flare system purged with nitrogen before any hydrocarbon introduction
activities.acceptance_criteria: All PSVs tagged and set at design pressure; flare header integrity and tip flow verified

activities.safety_hold_point: Temperature ramp rate must follow refractory manufacturer curve; continuous gas monitoring
activities.acceptance_criteria: Moisture content < 0.5% at outlet; temperature profile within ±10°C of specified ramp

activities.safety_hold_point: Oxygen content in regeneration gas < 1% prior to heating
activities.acceptance_criteria: Dew point at outlet < -40°C at design flow

activities.activity: Lube oil system flush and circulation
prerequisites: Lube oil piping complete and hydrotested
activities.safety_hold_point: Oil heater operation monitored at all times
activities.acceptance_criteria: Oil particle count per NAS 1638 Class 8 or better

prerequisites: Lube oil system flushed and circulating
activities.procedure_required: COM-014: Rotating equipment dry commissioning procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Coupling guard in place; emergency stop verified before run
activities.acceptance_criteria: Bearing temperature, vibration, and speed within OEM limits; no abnormal noise

activities.activity: Control valve stroking and ESD valve stroke test
activities.safety_hold_point: ESD valves to be stroked only with system de-pressurised and LOTO applied
activities.acceptance_criteria: Full stroke 0-100-0% within specified travel time; position feedback within 1%

activities.activity: Fire and gas system functional test
activities.procedure_required: COM-016: Fire and gas system test procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Fire alarm activation to be coordinated with site emergency response team
activities.acceptance_criteria: All detectors, alarms, and suppression activations verified per cause-and-effect matrix

activities.safety_hold_point: Chemical dosing locked out until basin integrity verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Design flow and head achieved; chemical treatment in spec; temperature approach within design

activities.activity: Instrument air and nitrogen system commissioning
activities.procedure_required: COM-018: Instrument air and nitrogen commissioning procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Nitrogen blanketing only after oxygen monitoring in place
activities.acceptance_criteria: Instrument air dew point < -40°C; nitrogen purity > 99.9% at all take-off points

activities.safety_hold_point: Steam lines preheated slowly; condensate drains open; personnel exclusion zone maintained
activities.acceptance_criteria: Pressure and temperature at user points within ±5%; steam quality > 99%

activities.activity: Feedstock handling and drying system commissioning
activities.safety_hold_point: Dust explosion prevention measures verified; inert gas blanketing operational
activities.acceptance_criteria: Feed rate within ±2% of design; biomass moisture content < 10 wt% after drying

activities.activity: Biomass feeding system lock hopper cycle test
activities.procedure_required: COM-021: Lock hopper cycle test procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Interlock bypass not permitted during cycle test; lock hopper pressurisation limited to design pressure
activities.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 10 consecutive cycles with correct sequence, pressure hold, and no bridging

activities.safety_hold_point: Syngas detection system functional before any gas introduction
activities.acceptance_criteria: Pressure integrity verified; valve sequence and logic correct; feeder system operational at design rate

activities.safety_hold_point: Oxygen supply isolation verified; continuous CO/H2 monitoring in area
activities.acceptance_criteria: Stable syngas composition (H2/CO ratio within ±10% of target) for 4 hours at minimum turndown

prerequisites: Gasifier hot commissioning producing stable syngas
activities.safety_hold_point: All vents routed to flare; H2S monitoring active in occupied areas
activities.acceptance_criteria: Outlet H2S < 0.1 ppmv; particulates < 0.1 mg/Nm³; temperature at FT inlet within design range

prerequisites: Syngas cleanup train commissioned and stable
activities.procedure_required: COM-025: Guard bed loading and activation procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Inert atmosphere maintained during loading; catalyst dust mask and respirator required
activities.acceptance_criteria: Bed loaded per spec; activation temperature profile achieved; breakthrough capacity verified

activities.activity: FT catalyst loading and in-situ reduction
activities.procedure_required: COM-026: FT catalyst loading and reduction procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Pyrophoric catalyst handling protocol in force; oxygen < 0.5% during reduction; hydrogen partial pressure monitored
activities.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst loaded uniformly; reduction completed per temperature profile; H2 consumption matches stoichiometry

activities.activity: FT loop pressurisation and syngas introduction
activities.safety_hold_point: ESD system verified; high-pressure leak test mandatory before syngas introduction
activities.acceptance_criteria: Loop pressurised to operating pressure; syngas flow established; no leaks detected

prerequisites: FT loop pressurised with syngas flow stable
activities.safety_hold_point: Temperature ramp limited to 5°C/hour; wax level in reactor monitored continuously
activities.acceptance_criteria: Steady-state CO conversion > 70%; wax production rate within design envelope; temperature profile uniform

prerequisites: FT reaction producing wax at design rate
activities.procedure_required: COM-029: Wax handling system commissioning procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Wax lines heat-traced and insulated; hot wax burn risk — full PPE required
activities.acceptance_criteria: Wax filtration, storage, and transfer operating at design temperature and flow; product wax quality meets spec

activities.procedure_required: COM-030: Hydrocracker catalyst loading and activation procedure
activities.safety_hold_point: Sulfiding agent handling protocol in place; H2S monitoring active
activities.acceptance_criteria: Catalyst loaded evenly; activation (sulfiding) completed per profile; catalyst activity confirmed

activities.safety_hold_point: Reactor temperature monitoring on high-integrity system; emergency depressurisation system verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: Reactor at operating temperature/pressure; wax conversion target met; product sulphur < 10 ppm

activities.safety_hold_point: Column inerted prior to hydrocarbon feed; level and pressure control loops verified
activities.acceptance_criteria: All product cuts on-spec (naphtha, jet, diesel); column pressures and temperatures stable for 8 hours

activities.procedure_required: COM-033: Product sampling and analysis protocol
activities.safety_hold_point: Aromatic/high-temp samples handled with appropriate PPE; sample bomb integrity checked
activities.acceptance_criteria: Representative samples taken per ASTM methods; full compositional and physical analysis report generated

prerequisites: Product sampling and initial lab analysis complete
activities.procedure_required: ASTM D7566 — Standard Specification for Aviation Turbine Fuel Containing Synthesized Hydrocarbons
activities.safety_hold_point: Fuel samples handled in grounded containers; static electricity prevention in force
activities.acceptance_criteria: All Annex A2 (FT-SPK) property limits met: freezing point, flash point, density, aromatics, distillation profile

prerequisites: Blend tank and in-line blending system commissioned
activities.safety_hold_point: Blend ratio limited to 50% FT-SPK per D7566; batch documentation reviewed before blending
activities.acceptance_criteria: 50% blend with conventional Jet A-1 meets all D7566 specification requirements; no phase separation

activities.safety_hold_point: Test aborted if any safety-critical alarm activates; continuous operations team coverage required
activities.acceptance_criteria: 72 continuous hours at > 90% design capacity; product quality on-spec; utility consumption within guarantees; SAF product batch meets ASTM D7566 Annex A2
